outcome: Presence or absence of ovulation (as assessed by ultrasound monitoring)
cohort: The study included 228 patients (aged 18-38 years) with infertility for at least one year who underwent complete examination and ovulation monitoring.
finding: Self-reported menstrual regularity (regular or irregular) significantly correlates with the presence or absence of ovulation, making it a reliable indicator for infertility etiology.
cross-section timing: At the time of ovulation monitoring
